name: perfect-prompt
description: Makes your first prompt complete before the main model sees it: a cheap-model gate, one round of grounded questions (one dialog each), context from your notes folder and project, optional web best practices, the assembled prompt in your prompt box for review, and lessons learned after each task.

mode.title: How the enhanced prompt is sent
mode.description: review: the assembled prompt lands in your prompt box and you press Enter; auto: it is sent at once

model.title: Cheap model for the gate, questions, assembly and reflection
model.description: An alias (haiku, sonnet) or a full model id

vaultPath.title: Notes folder (optional)
vaultPath.description: A folder with your standing rules and memory notes, for example an Obsidian vault; ~ is your home folder. The default is your Claude Code config folder. A missing folder or file is skipped.

rulesFile.title: Rules file inside the notes folder
rulesFile.description: Read as your standing rules (head only). Relative to the notes folder, or an absolute path. With the default folder this is your global CLAUDE.md.

memoryIndex.title: Memory index inside the notes folder
memoryIndex.description: A markdown index with one line per fact file, '- [Title](file.md) - summary'; the cheap model picks up to 6 files from it and they are read from the index's folder. Relative to the notes folder, or an absolute path.

webSearch.title: Web best practices
webSearch.description: ask: one of the questions offers a web search; auto: always search; off: never

maxQuestions.title: Questions per round
maxQuestions.description: 1 to 3 content questions; the dialog also carries the web and continue questions

minWords.title: Shortest prompt that is checked
minWords.description: Prompts with fewer words are sent unchanged
